text:
priyanka: Heads-up — planning to flip audit_mode + pii_log_mask toggles for beta customers tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need KMS/HSM fallback and retention guardrails confirmed. Any blockers?
kevin: Scope? beta orgs only or internal smoke first? which flag keys are we toggling?
priyanka: beta only. flag keys: `feature.audit_mode_v2`, `feature.pii_log_masking_v1`. Canary list attached below. We'll do internal smoke at 08:30 PT.
priyanka: ```
canary_orgs = [
  "org-beta-17",
  "org-beta-42",
  "org-beta-88"
]
rollout_plan = ["internal-smoke -> canary (30m) -> beta (2h) -> all"]
```
sasha: KMS path question: if primary KMS is unavailable, what's the fallback? HSM? local envelope? need detail for audit-mode because logs will be encrypted.
priyanka: Fallback plan: runtime tries customer KMS key (ARN) -> team fallback KMS -> if KMS unavailable, fall back to ephemeral service key encrypted in HSM. Env var: `KMS_FALLBACK=enabled`. We have a small migration to ensure keys are cached before flip.
maria: Retention guardrails: for canary set `retention_days=30`. For beta we keep 30 by default, for all we will move to 90 after approval. I'll run config update. SQL to update config store: ```UPDATE config_store SET value='30' WHERE key='audit.retention_days' AND org_id IN ('org-beta-17','org-beta-42','org-beta-88');```
kevin: Telemetry: add a smoke alert for errors > 1% and latency regression > 20% on `/audit/log` endpoints. Also create an alert if KMS fallback is used > 5% of requests for 10m.
priyanka: Added alert rules in ops: https://app.ops/alerts/RED-1254 (action: page on pagerduty). Can someone sanity check?
oliver: I'll review the PR for the flag flip (repo: infra/feature-flags, PR #482). Linking: https://git.internal/repo/infra/feature-flags/pull/482
oliver: Quick note — PR includes a `force_fallback=true` test flag to validate fallback path during smoke.
kevin: @oliver I'll review in next hour. If LGTM I'll merge and schedule deploy.
deploy-bot: Scheduled flag change: feature.audit_mode_v2 -> enable for canary at 2026-05-10T16:00:00Z (deployment window 09:00 PT).
nana: typo — that's me (ana). Security check: confirm audit logs are written to the secure bucket and that bucket key policy uses CMK. Need KMS ARN here for records.
priyanka: Confirmed. Bucket: `s3://redwood-audit-logs-prod`, CMK ARN placeholder `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345`. We'll set bucket policy and key rotation.
maria: I'll handle the DB config update and run smoke tests after the internal smoke at 08:30. Will post results here.
sasha: One more: add runtime guardrail to reject write attempts that include unmasked PII when `pii_log_masking_v1` is enabled. Fail-fast with 400 + telemetry.
priyanka: Agreed — implemented server-side check in `audit-service` branch. PR included in the link above.
oliver: tagging security reviewers: @ana please confirm key handling, and @kevin please double-check alert thresholds.
nana: (ana) I'll audit the CMK policy and confirm. Expect a short note by EOD.
kevin: If no regressions in 30m canary, expand to beta. If still clean after 2h expand to all. Rolling back plan: set `feature.audit_mode_v2=false` and `feature.pii_log_masking_v1=false`, clear ephemeral keys, and run rollback script: `scripts/rollback_audit_toggle.sh`.
priyanka: Thanks all. Final checklist: PR merged, deploy scheduled, retention updated, alerts created, security sign-off. Will post post-mortem if anything odd pops up. :thumbsup:
